source_refs.note: Electric Fans and Electric Motors: a main subheading of 16.10 Use of Capacitors, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 80-81.

blocks.text: A capacitor is connected to the starting of fan motor. When the power is turned ON the capacitor starts charging, i.e., it accumulates charge. During the process of starting of fan motor, it provides additional power, helping the motor to overcome static friction and initial resistance due to inertia. In thin way, it enables the fan motor to start and begin spinning quickly. The same role is played by the capacitor in motors used in washing machines, electric blenders, choppers, grinders, water drawing motors etc.

blocks.title: Book correction
blocks.text: The book says the capacitor provides additional power to start the motor. It does not supply extra power or energy: it shifts the phase of the current in the starting coil relative to the running coil, so that the two coils produce a rotating magnetic field, which gives the motor its starting torque.
